en: The understanding of a person who is attached to earthly object becomes more and more entangled in the net of stupefaction. The man who becomes entangled in the net of stupefaction comes by sorrow both in this world and in the next.

sa: अनिष्टस्याभिनिर्वृत्तिमिष्टसंवृत्तिमेव च। अप्रयत्नेन पश्यामः केषाञ्चित् तत्स्वभावतः॥
en: In the case of some, we see that without any exertion on their part, what is not desired is not brought about and what is desired, is done. This then must be the result of Nature.

sa: माभ्यामश्विभ्यां नकुलसहदेवावुत्पादितौ॥
en: And Madri gave birth by the Ashvinis, the twins Nakula and Sahadeva.

sa: अर्चयामास देवांश्च द्विजांश्च यदुपुङ्गवः। माल्यजाप्यनमस्कारैर्गन्धैरुच्चावचैरपि।॥
en: The best of the Yadu race, (Krishna) then worshipped the celestials and the Brahmanas with garlands, with mantras, with various kinds of excellent perfumes and with bowing down his head.

sa: कूर्मस्त्रियोजनोत्सेधो दशयोजनमण्डलः। तावुभौ युद्धसंमत्तौ परस्परवधैषिणौ।॥
en: The tortoise is also three Yojanas in height and his circumference is ten Yojanas. Eat up both of these animals, madly engaged in battle and bent upon killing each other.

sa: ततोऽस्य वेश्मावयजनोपशोभितं विस्तीर्णपद्मोत्पलभूषिताजिरम्। बलौघररत्नौघविचित्रमाबभौ नभो यथा निर्मलतारकान्वितम्॥
en: Adorned with that concourse of chief men, with its court-yards decked with lotuses and lilies and beautified with the lines of troops and fastened round with diamonds and precious stones, his (Drupada's) palace looked like the sky studded with the brilliant stars.

sa: यतिभिर्वालखिल्यैश्च वृतं मुनिगान्वितम्। अग्न्यगारैश्च बहुभिः पुष्पसंस्तरसंस्तृतम्॥
en: He saw innumerable Yatis, Valakhilyas and other Munis sitting there in that hermitage). It was adorned with rooms containing the sacrificial fire. The flowers, dropping from the trees, had made a beautiful carpet on the ground.

sa: तथा मूर्धाभिषिक्तैश्च नानाजनपदेश्वरैः। ऋत्विग्भिर्ब्रह्मकल्पैश्च कुशलैर्यज्ञसंस्तरे॥
en: He was surrounded by kings of various countries who had undergone the sacred baths and by competent Ritvijas who were like Brahma himself all seated comfortably in the sacrificial grounds.

sa: तत्रोपविष्टार्जिरिवानलस्य तेषां जनित्रीति मम प्रतर्कः। रुपोपविष्टैस्त्रिभिरग्निकल्पैः॥
en: There (in the potter's house) sat a lady, as effulgent as a flame of fire, who I believe, is their mother. Around her also sat three foremost of men, each of when was like a fire.

sa: ऐन्द्रिमप्रतिमं द्रोण उपदेशेष्वमन्यता एवं सर्वकुमाराणामिष्वस्त्रं प्रत्यपादयत्॥
en: Though he (Drona) gave equal instructions to all, yet Arjuna became the foremost of all in lightness and skill. Drona was convinced that none of his pupils would be able to equal that son of Indra.

sa: दन्तहस्ताग्रलांगूलपदावेगेन वीर्यवान्। विक्षोभयंस्ततोनागः सरो बहुझषाकुलम्॥
en: The greatly powerful elephant, with the motion of his tusks and fore-part of his trunk and with tail and feet, violently agitates the water of the lakes full of fishes.

sa: असङ्गो देवविहितस्तस्मिन् रथवरे ध्वजः। योजनाद् ददृशे श्रीमानिन्द्रायुधसमप्रभः॥
en: On this best of cars there was a flag-staff without being visibly attached thereto. It was the product of celestials art. That beautiful flat staff could be seen from a distance of a Yojana, and it had the splendour of the rainbow.

sa: नाश्रोत्रियः श्रोत्रियस्य नारथी रथिनः सखा। नाराजा पार्थिवस्यापि सखिपूर्व किमिष्यते॥
en: One of pure birth can never be a friend of one, who is lowly born; a car warrior cannot be a friend of one, who is not a car warrior. One who is not a king cannot have a king for his friend. How then do you desire the continuance of our old friendship?"

sa: भीमसेनभयाद्यत्र दैवेनाभिप्रचोदितः। अपाण्डवायेति रुषा द्रौणिरस्त्रमवासृजत्॥
en: The son of Drona, out of fear of Bhima and as fate would have it discharged the celestial weapon, crying “Let it make the world free of all the Pandavas."

sa: मृगव्यवायनिधनात्कृच्छ्रां प्राप स आपदम्। जन्मप्रभृति पार्थानां तत्राचारविधिक्रमः॥
en: As a sportsman he brought upon himself a very great misfortune by killing a stag when it was with its mate. Pandu's misfortune served as a warning for the conduct of all the princes of his house as long as they lived.

sa: अव्यक्तमक्षरं ब्रह्म प्रधानं त्रिगुणात्मकम्। आत्मानमव्ययं चैव प्रकृति प्रभवं प्रभुम्॥
en: He is called by the learned the invisible cause of all, he knows no deterioration, he is the first Brahma, he is the abode of the three qualities (Satya, Raja and Tama), he is the great soul, he is undeteriorating, he is the first, the cause of the creation, the Nature, the controlling Lord.

sa: निवृत्तकृषिगोरक्षा विध्वस्तनगराश्रमा। अस्थिकङ्कालसंकीर्णा भूर्वभूवोग्रदर्शना॥
en: Agriculture was neglected and cattle were not tended; both cities and hermitages became desolate. The earth, being covered with bones and skeletons, looked fearful,

sa: सवैरतैर्मदैर्मत्तावन्योन्यं भृकुटीकृतौ। मदकामसमाविष्टौ परस्परमथोचतुः॥
en: Intoxicated with all this and maddened with desire, each of them contracted his eyebrows in anger; and they then spoke thus to each other.

sa: तस्य वीरस्य विक्रान्तैः सहस्रशतदक्षिणैः। अश्वमैधशतैरीजे धृतराष्ट्रो महामखैः॥
en: Dhritarashtra performed with the wealth acquired by that hero five great sacrifices, in which offerings were made to the Brahmanas by hundreds and thousands and in which so much wealth was spent as would have been sufficient for one hundred Horse sacrifices.

sa: प्रच्छाद्यमानं द्विरदैर्मेधैरिव दिवाकरम्। प्रययुः पाण्डुपश्चाला नदन्तो निशितायुधाः॥
en: Both the Pandus and the Panchalas, uttering loud roars and being furnished with the sharp weapons, advanced towards him (the Panchala chief) who was then closed with by those elephants even as the sun is covered over with the masses of clouds.

sa: शूलप्रासासिमुसलजलप्रस्रवणो महान्॥ तमञ्जनगिरिप्रख्यं द्रौणिदृष्ट्वा महीधरम्।
en: And having a great fountain of water from which spears, lances, swords and heavy clubs, flowed incessantly. The son of Drona, beholding that mountain looking like a mass of antimony.

sa: व्यूढोरस्को महाबाहुर्मत्तद्विरदविक्रमः। चकोरनेत्रस्ताम्रास्यो द्विषतां भयवर्धनः॥
en: Of broad breast, mighty arms, possessed of the tread of an infuriate elephant, of eyes like those of the Chakara, that inspirer of terror into the heart of the foes!

sa: अन्योन्यमभिवीक्षन्तौ गोष्ठेष्विव महर्षभौ। महागजाविवासाद्य विषाणाप्रैः परस्परम्॥
en: Like two mighty bulls in a herd of cows, at times they looked at each other with eyes flashing rage. At another time, like two prodigious elephants striking each other with the point of their tusks.

sa: दग्धाद्रिकूटशृङ्गाभं भिन्नाञ्जनचयोपमम्। रथाद् रथमभिदुत्य क्रुद्धो हैडिम्बिराक्षिपत्॥
en: Car that resembled in effulgence the summit of a burning hill or a broken heap of antimony. Burning with rage, Hidimba's son flew for his own chariot to that of his adversary and seized the latter.

sa: वषट्कार :प्रतोदोऽभूद्गायत्री शीर्षबन्धना॥
en: The Vashatkara (the chief Vedic sound) formed the goad; and Gayatri formed the chord attacked to the goad.

sa: ततः प्रयातो दाशार्हः श्रुत्वा पाण्डवभाषितम्। रथेनातिपताकेन मनोमारुतरंहसा॥
en: Hearing those words of Arjuna Krishna drove his car adorned with many banners and fleet like the wind or the mind. Hearing those words of Arjuna Krishna drove his car adorned with many banners and fleet like the wind or the mind.

sa: योधमुख्या महावीर्याः पाण्डूनां कर्णमाहवे। शीघ्रास्त्रास्तूर्णमावृत्य परिवठ्ठः समन्ततः॥
en: Then, again, the best of the warriors of the vast Pandava force, who were all very powerful and who also were very sinart in the management of weapons, after having careered round, surrounded Karna from all sides in the field of battle.

sa: तेषामाददतः प्राणानासीदाधिरथेवपुः॥ शोणिताभ्युक्षिताङ्गस्य रुद्रस्येवोर्जितं महत्।
en: When the son of Adhiratha was engaged in striking those heroes his body, besmeared with blood and swelled with pride and animation, looked like the gigantic form of Rudra himself.

sa: स्तथा प्रवक्ष्याम्यहमर्थसिद्धये। इत्येमुक्तः पुरुषोत्तमेन सुदुःखितः केशवमर्जुनोऽब्रवीत्॥
en: If you have anything to ask, be out with it. I will tell you how to gain your desired ends." Being thus spoken to by Keshava, the foremost of men, the remorse-stricken Dhananjaya repliedअहं हनिष्ये स्वशरीरमेव

sa: हिरण्यवर्मा निशितैः प्रुषत्केस्तवात्मजानामनिलात्मजो वै। अतापयत् सैन्यमतीव भीमः काले शुचौ मध्यगतो यथार्कः॥
en: Here, the son of the Wind-god, Bhima, covered with armor of gold, afflicting with his keen shafts, like the burning mid-day Sun of summer, scorched the while body of troops of your sons. Here, the son of the Wind-god, Bhima, covered with armor of gold, afflicting with his keen shafts, like the burning mid-day Sun of summer, scorched the while body of troops of your sons.

sa: शस्राकृतिभिराकीर्णमतीव पुरुषर्षभ। दृष्ट्वान्तरिक्षमाविग्नाः पाण्डुपाञ्चालसृञ्जयाः॥
en: Then beholding the firmament densely covered by those weapons, O foremost of the Bharatas, the Pandavas, the Sanjaya and the Panchalas became exceedingly anxious.

sa: अभ्यर्दितस्तु तैर्जिष्णुः शक्रतुल्यपराक्रमः॥ ऐन्द्रमस्त्रममेयात्मा प्रादुश्चक्रे महारथः।
en: Having been thus oppressed by those weapons, that mighty car-warrior, Jishnu, who was possessed of prowess equal to that of Sakra (Indra) himself and who also had a soul immeasurable, took up his weapon, called Aindra.

sa: विहतान् रथिनस्तत्र धावमानांस्ततस्ततः। सूतपुत्रशरैस्तीक्ष्णैर्हन्यमानान् विशाम्पते॥ विशस्त्रांश्च तथैवान्यान् सशस्त्रांश्च हतान् बहून्।
en: O ruler of earth, there is the field of battle we saw numerous car-warriors rushing in all directions who were deprived of their cars and who also were afflicted by the arrows of the son of Suta and some of whom, again, were divested of their weapons, and innumerable Other car-warriors were seen slaughtered there still with their weapons on.

sa: शरानास्तीर्य सव्येन पाणिना पुण्यलक्षणः। यियासुर्ब्रह्मलोकाय प्राणान् प्राणेष्वथाजुहोत्॥
en: Distinguished by many pious deeds, he then spread with his left hand a bed of arrows and out of a desire for going to the regions of Brahman, he committed his vital breaths to the care of the gods presiding over them.

sa: सुकल्पिताः स्यन्दनवाजिनागा: समास्थिताः कृतयत्नकृतैर्नृवीरैः। स्तैरेव साधु नृवरा निपेतुः॥
en: The excellently ornamented cars, horses and elephants, that were ridden over by heroes among men, who were capable of fighting with the greatest care, were smitten down with hundreds of arrows shot by the son of Pritha. Along with these the foremost of heroes among men fell down.

sa: हातविशिष्टांस्तुरगानर्जुनेन महाबलान्। भीमो व्यधमदश्रान्तो गदापाणिर्महाहवे॥
en: Bhima of inexhaustible prowess, with mace in his hand, slaughtered in that great battle the remnant of the mighty Kaurava cavalry that were left after the havoc made by Arjuna.

sa: तदाप्रभृति मां शोको दहत्यग्निरिवाशयम्। ग्रस्तानिव प्रपश्यामि भूमिपालान् ससैन्धवान्।॥
en: Like fire burning down a heap of dry grass, grief is corroding my heart since I have heard of Dhananjaya's entrance into my army. I see that all the king's of the earth with the ruler of the Sindhus amongst them, are under the influence of adverse Fate.

sa: रुधिरोक्षितसर्वाङ्गौ कुरुवृष्णियशस्करौ। परस्परमवेक्षेतां दहन्ताविव लोचनैः॥
en: With their bodies covered all over with blood, those two renowned descendants of Kuru and Vrishni eyed at each other as it (desirous of) consuming each other with their glances.

sa: तदद्भुतं महद् युद्धं कर्णपाण्डवयोर्मधे॥ क्रुद्धयोर्वासिताहेतोर्वन्ययोर्गजयोरिव।
en: Then a marvellous encounter took place between Karna and the of Pandu resembling that between two wild elephants for the sake of a she-elephant in the time of her passion.

sa: व्यदृश्यत निमेषेण
en: then coming upon the division of the Bhojas, protected by Hridika's son.

sa: सर्वयोधगुणैर्युक्तो मित्राणामभयंकरः। सततं पाण्डवद्वेषी धार्तराष्ट्रहिते रतः॥
en: He possesses all the necessary attributes of an warrior and is a dispeller of the fears of his friends, always hostile to the Pandavas and ever bent upon doing good turns to the sons of Dhritarashtra.

sa: समन्ताज्जालदप्रख्यान् वारणान् मदवर्षिणः। अभिपेदेऽर्जुनरथो धनान् भिन्दनिवांशुमान्॥
en: Heaps of carcasses of elephants with greasy matter oozing out of them looked like clouds and as the sun stands out in relief dispersing the clouds, so Dhananjaya's car passed through these masses of dead elephants.

sa: अथास्य बाहू द्विपहस्तसंनिभौ शिरश्च पूर्णेन्दुनिभाननं त्रिभिः। स्ततो द्विपं बाणशतैः समार्पयत्॥
en: Thereupon the son of Pandu cut-off, as if at the same time, the two arms, that resembled the trunks of elephants and the head, that was furnished with a face like the full moon, of him, (his antagonist) with his broad-headed arrows, the latter with three, like the razor. He, again, poured forth hundreds of shafts upon his enemy's elephant.

sa: वराहः सिन्धुराजस्य राजतोऽभिविराजते॥ ध्वजाग्रेऽलोहितार्काभो हेमजालपरिष्कृतः।
en: The device of a silver boar shone on the standard of the Sindhu king; it was decked with garlands of gold and was of the splendour of the rising sun.

sa: भीमसेनस्तदाबानं कर्णान्नामर्षयद् युधि। अर्धमण्डलमावृत्य सूतपुत्रमयोधयत्॥
en: Sanjaya said Bhimasena then did not put up with that challenge of Karna tamely. But wheeling his car in a semicircle, be began to fight with the son of Suta.

sa: वसृक् स्त्रवन्तौ धनदेन्द्रकल्पौ। समाप्तविधेन तथाभिभूतौ हतौ रणे ताविति मेनिरेऽन्ये॥
en: All the people considered these two foremost of persons, resembling Kubera and Indra, who being struck with those arrows, were drenched in blood (i.e. blood having flowed down their limbs) and who were highly afflicted by that one, who had completed his education (in the science of arms), slain in the field of battle.

sa: क्ष्वेडितास्फोटितोत्क्रुष्टैस्तुमुलं सर्वतोऽभवत्। बाहुशब्दैश्च शूराणां कर्णार्जुनसमागमे॥
en: In that contest between Karna and Arjuna fearful noise arose on account of the shouts and lion-like roars of warriors and for the striking of their palms over their arm-pits.

sa: मयूरो वृषसेनस्य काञ्चनो मणिरत्नवान्॥ व्याहरिष्यन्निवातिष्ठत् सेनाग्रमुपशोभयन्।
en: Vrishasena had for his device a peacock made of gold and decked with gems and jewels beautifying the van of the army it stood on his standard as if on the point of emitting its notes.

sa: महाबलैर्भीमरवैः संरम्भोवृत्तलोचनैः॥ उपस्थितैस्ततो युद्धे राक्षसैयुद्धदुर्मदैः।
en: Were dreadful to look at, excited with wrath and their eyes were rolling in ire. Accompanied by those Rakshasas difficult of being vanquished. (Ghatotkacha) appeared on the field of battle.

sa: द्रोणग्राहह्रदान्मुक्तौ शक्त्याशीविषसंकटात्। अयःशरोग्रमकरात् क्षत्रियप्रवराम्भसः॥
en: Having passed through that expensive lake, of which Drona formed the shark, darts the fierce snakes, shafts the Makaras and Kshatriyas the fathomless waters.

sa: गृध्रोदग्रमहाग्राहां शिवाविरुतभैरवाम्। नृत्यत्प्रेतपिशाचाद्यैर्भूताकीर्णा सहस्रशः॥
en: And vultures for its fierce aquatic animals; echoing with the yells of jackals; infested with dancing ghosts and Pisachas and Pretas, thousands in number.

sa: संचिन्वानकमेवैनं कामानामवितृप्तकम्। व्याघ्रः पशुमिवासाद्य मृत्युरादाय गच्छति।॥
en: Like a tiger seizing and running away with its prey, Death seizes and runs away with the man, who is engaged in such occupation and which is still not satiated with objects of desire and enjoyment.

sa: महाकाया महावेगाः शैलशृङ्गसमुच्छ्रयाः। योजनायामविस्तारा द्वियोजनसमायताः॥
en: They had huge bodies and great speed, they were as tall as mountain peaks. Some of them were as long as a Yama, some a Yojana and some two Yojanas.

sa: एवमेव समुद्विष्टः श्राद्धकालक्रमस्तथा। विधिः पात्रं फलं चैव यथावदनुकीर्तिमम्॥
en: Thus have been laid down the proper time for the performance of the Shraddha, the ordinances about the rites to be observed the proper person that should be fed at the Shraddha, and the merits that belong to it. I have described everything to you in due orders.

sa: पृष्ठच्छिन्नान् विचरणान् बाहुपार्वेक्षणाकुलान्। नानाडावयवैीनांश्चकारारीन् धनंजयः॥
en: Some had their backs lacerated, some were deprived of their legs, some were hit on the arms, backs and eyes; thus Dhananjaya made his enemies deprived of their various limbs.

sa: कृपणानाथवृद्धानां दुर्बलातुरयोषिताम्। संविभक्तास्मि सर्वेषां मामकान्तरमाविशः॥
en: I support the helpless and the old, the weak, the ill, and helpless women by giving them all their necessaries. How then have you been able to possess my heart?

sa: मौर्वीभुजाग्रप्रहितान् स्म तात दोधूयमानेन धनुर्धरेण। नजिह्मगान् कच्चिदनुस्मरन्ति॥
en: Do they remember, the arrows shot from the Gandiva bow by means of the string of the bow and dexterity of the hands, the former shaking often and again and making a noise like the roaring of the clouds and flying swiftly.

sa: मन्यानि चाङ्गानि तथा बलं च। ब्रह्मार्थयोगेन च ब्रह्मचर्यम्॥
en: The effects of the practice of asceticism, which is made up of twelve constituent elements including righteousness and the effects of Angas and Balam (particular forms of asceticism) are said to be obtained by contact with the preceptor and by an earnest desire to know the Supreme Soul.

sa: नानाप्रदक्षिणैर्यज्ञैर्यजन्ते विषये मम। नाधीते नाव्रती कश्चिन्मामकान्तरमाविशः॥
en: In my kingdom no sacrifice has been celebrated without completing it by Dakshina. No one in my kingdom studies the Vedas who does not observe vows. How then have you been able to possess my soul?
